units.context: Configuration (config.ini or environment variables)

units.source: Trilium supports configuration via a file named __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and environment variables. This document provides a comprehensive reference for all configuration options.
units.context: Configuration (config.ini or environment variables)
Configuration (config.ini or environment variables) > Location of the configuration file

units.source: The configuration file is not located in the same directory as the application. Instead, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ is located in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Data directory__TRILIUM_PH_2__. As such, the configuration file is only available after starting the application and creating a database.
units.context: Configuration (config.ini or environment variables) > Location of the configuration file

Configuration (config.ini or environment variables) > Environment Variable Patterns

units.source: Trilium supports multiple environment variable patterns for flexibility. The primary pattern is: __TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Configuration (config.ini or environment variables) > Environment Variable Patterns
Configuration (config.ini or environment variables) > Environment Variable Patterns

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ is the INI section name in UPPERCASE
units.context: Configuration (config.ini or environment variables) > Environment Variable Patterns

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ is the camelCase configuration key converted to UPPERCASE (e.g., __TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__)
units.context: Configuration (config.ini or environment variables) > Environment Variable Patterns

units.source: Additionally, shorter aliases are available for common configurations (see Alternative Variables section below).
